# Web Login Route + TanStack File-Based Routing Implementation Plan

> **For agentic workers:** REQUIRED SUB-SKILL: Use superpowers:subagent-driven-development (recommended) or superpowers:executing-plans to implement this plan task-by-task. Steps use checkbox (`- [ ]`) syntax for tracking.

**Goal:** Remove the Vite boilerplate theme and wire TanStack file-based routing with a `/login` route that renders a shadcn `login-01`-based login form (submit stubbed).

**Architecture:** `main.tsx` mounts `<RouterProvider>` driven by an auto-generated `routeTree.gen.ts`. Routes in `src/routes/` are thin; `/login` renders `LoginPage` (`components/pages/login.tsx`) which renders the reusable `Login` form (`components/auth/login.tsx`). The form uses TanStack Form + zod with a stubbed `onSubmit`.

**Tech Stack:** Vite 8, React 19, `@tanstack/react-router` + `@tanstack/router-plugin`, `@tanstack/react-form`, zod, shadcn (base-lyra), Tailwind v4, bun.

**Environment note:** `bun`/`bunx` live at `~/.bun/bin` and are NOT on PATH by default. Prefix bun commands with `export PATH="$HOME/.bun/bin:$PATH"` (or run from a shell where it's exported). All commands below run from `apps/web/` unless noted. The repo husky pre-commit hook runs `turbo run lint format:check`; it currently fails on pre-existing `react-refresh/only-export-components` errors in `components/ui/{badge,button}.tsx`. Those are unrelated to this work — if the hook blocks a commit on ONLY those two pre-existing errors, commit with `--no-verify`; do NOT bypass for errors in files this plan touches.

## Task 1: Install router plugin and wire Vite

**Files:**
- Modify: `apps/web/package.json`
- Modify: `apps/web/vite.config.ts`

- [ ] **Step 1: Add the router plugin dependency**

```bash
cd apps/web && export PATH="$HOME/.bun/bin:$PATH"
bun add -D @tanstack/router-plugin
```

Expected: `@tanstack/router-plugin` appears in `devDependencies` in `package.json` and `bun.lock` updates. Confirm the installed version matches the `@tanstack/react-router` major (both `^1.x`):

```bash
bun pm ls | grep -E "@tanstack/(react-router|router-plugin)"
```

- [ ] **Step 2: Wire the plugin into vite.config.ts**

Edit `apps/web/vite.config.ts`. Add the import and place `tanstackRouter()` BEFORE `react()` in the plugins array (the codegen plugin must run first). Keep the existing `resolve.alias` block unchanged.

```ts
import path from "node:path";
import tailwindcss from "@tailwindcss/vite";
import { tanstackRouter } from "@tanstack/router-plugin/vite";
import react from "@vitejs/plugin-react";
import { defineConfig } from "vite";

// https://vite.dev/config/
export default defineConfig({
  plugins: [
    tanstackRouter({ target: "react", autoCodeSplitting: true }),
    react(),
    tailwindcss(),
  ],
  resolve: {
    alias: {
      "@/components/ui": path.resolve(import.meta.dirname, "./src/components/ui"),
      "@/components": path.resolve(import.meta.dirname, "./src/components"),
      "@/lib": path.resolve(import.meta.dirname, "./src/lib"),
      "@/hooks": path.resolve(import.meta.dirname, "./src/hooks"),
      "@": path.resolve(import.meta.dirname, "./src"),
    },
  },
});
```

- [ ] **Step 3: Ignore the generated route tree**

Append to `apps/web/.gitignore`:

```

src/routeTree.gen.ts
```


## Task 3: Generate login-01 block and create the auth form

`login-01` is a shadcn block (a login card with email/password). Its generated files and the exact set of primitives it pulls (card, button, input, label, etc.) are not known until the command runs. This task runs it, then relocates the block component to `components/auth/login.tsx` exporting a `Login` component, and rewrites its submit to a stub using TanStack Form + zod.

**Files:**
- Create (generated, then relocated): `apps/web/src/components/auth/login.tsx`
- Create (generated): new primitives under `apps/web/src/components/ui/` (e.g. `card.tsx`, `label.tsx`)
- Delete: whatever block file `login-01` generates (after relocating its content)

- [ ] **Step 1: Generate the block**

```bash
cd apps/web && export PATH="$HOME/.bun/bin:$PATH"
bunx shadcn@latest add login-01
```

Expected: shadcn writes a block component (commonly `src/components/login-form.tsx` and/or a `src/components/blocks/...` file) plus any missing primitives into `src/components/ui/` (per `components.json` alias). Accept overwrite prompts for primitives only if it offers to overwrite existing button/input — prefer "no" / keep existing if prompted; the existing ones already work.

- [ ] **Step 2: Identify what was generated**

```bash
git status --porcelain apps/web/src
```

Note the new block file path (the non-`ui/` `.tsx` it created) and any new `ui/*.tsx` primitives. The block file is the one to relocate.

- [ ] **Step 3: Relocate the block into components/auth/login.tsx**

Move the generated block file to `apps/web/src/components/auth/login.tsx`. Then edit it so:
- The exported component is named `Login` (rename from `LoginForm`/whatever shadcn used; update its `export`).
- It accepts no required props (drop any `className`/`...props` spread requirement, or keep an optional `className?: string`).
- The submit handler is a stub backed by TanStack Form + zod. Replace the form body with this exact implementation (adjust only the imported primitive paths to match what `login-01` generated — typically `card`, `input`, `label`, `button` all under `@/components/ui/`):

```tsx
import { useForm } from "@tanstack/react-form";
import { z } from "zod";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import {
  Card,
  CardContent,
  CardDescription,
  CardHeader,
  CardTitle,
} from "@/components/ui/card";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import { Label } from "@/components/ui/label";

const loginSchema = z.object({
  email: z.string().email("Enter a valid email"),
  password: z.string().min(8, "Password must be at least 8 characters"),
});

export function Login({ className }: { className?: string }) {
  const form = useForm({
    defaultValues: { email: "", password: "" },
    validators: { onChange: loginSchema },
    onSubmit: async ({ value }) => {
      // Stub: no auth backend wired yet.
      console.log("login submit", value);
    },
  });

  return (
    <Card className={className}>
      <CardHeader>
        <CardTitle className="text-2xl">Login</CardTitle>
        <CardDescription>
          Enter your email below to login to your account
        </CardDescription>
      </CardHeader>
      <CardContent>
        <form
          onSubmit={(e) => {
            e.preventDefault();
            e.stopPropagation();
            void form.handleSubmit();
          }}
          className="flex flex-col gap-6"
        >
          <form.Field name="email">
            {(field) => (
              <div className="grid gap-2">
                <Label htmlFor={field.name}>Email</Label>
                <Input
                  id={field.name}
                  name={field.name}
                  type="email"
                  placeholder="m@example.com"
                  value={field.state.value}
                  onBlur={field.handleBlur}
                  onChange={(e) => field.handleChange(e.target.value)}
                />
                {field.state.meta.errors.length > 0 && (
                  <p className="text-destructive text-sm">
                    {String(field.state.meta.errors[0]?.message ?? field.state.meta.errors[0])}
                  </p>
                )}
              </div>
            )}
          </form.Field>

          <form.Field name="password">
            {(field) => (
              <div className="grid gap-2">
                <Label htmlFor={field.name}>Password</Label>
                <Input
                  id={field.name}
                  name={field.name}
                  type="password"
                  value={field.state.value}
                  onBlur={field.handleBlur}
                  onChange={(e) => field.handleChange(e.target.value)}
                />
                {field.state.meta.errors.length > 0 && (
                  <p className="text-destructive text-sm">
                    {String(field.state.meta.errors[0]?.message ?? field.state.meta.errors[0])}
                  </p>
                )}
              </div>
            )}
          </form.Field>

          <form.Subscribe selector={(s) => [s.canSubmit, s.isSubmitting]}>
            {([canSubmit, isSubmitting]) => (
              <Button type="submit" className="w-full" disabled={!canSubmit}>
                {isSubmitting ? "Logging in..." : "Login"}
              </Button>
            )}
          </form.Subscribe>
        </form>
      </CardContent>
    </Card>
  );
}
```

## Task 4: Switch entry point to the router

**Files:**
- Modify: `apps/web/src/main.tsx`

- [ ] **Step 1: Generate the route tree once**

Running dev/build triggers codegen. Generate it now so the import in Step 2 resolves:

```bash
cd apps/web && export PATH="$HOME/.bun/bin:$PATH"
bun run dev &
sleep 4 && kill %1 2>/dev/null || true
ls src/routeTree.gen.ts
```

Expected: `src/routeTree.gen.ts` exists.

- [ ] **Step 2: Replace main.tsx**

Overwrite `apps/web/src/main.tsx`:

```tsx
import { StrictMode } from "react";
import { createRoot } from "react-dom/client";
import { createRouter, RouterProvider } from "@tanstack/react-router";
import "./index.css";
import { routeTree } from "./routeTree.gen";

const router = createRouter({ routeTree });

declare module "@tanstack/react-router" {
  interface Register {
    router: typeof router;
  }
}

createRoot(document.getElementById("root")!).render(
  <StrictMode>
    <RouterProvider router={router} />
  </StrictMode>,
);
```
